Set in colonial India in 1856, this satirical film traces the fate of Awadh, a small kingdom ruled by Wajid Ali Shah (Amjad Khan) and his team of disinterested governors. Two noblemen, Mir (Saeed Jaffrey) and Mirza (Sanjeev Kumar) go a step further and devote themselves to endless rounds of chess, while the British proceed to annex the kingdom and oust its ruler.
